title.narrative: Mobile Integrated assistance to the most vulnerable populations.

description.narrative: ltpgtThrough the Integrated Mobile Assistance for the Most Vulnerable Groups project, the needs of vulnerable people whose lives and livelihoods have been directly threatened by protracted displacement, poor economic conditions, hyperinflation, escalating hostilities, and the aftermath of the earthquake will be met. The project focused on a comprehensive response to their needs within deprived areas affected by the ongoing conflict for 13 years to support and enhance vital basic services and enhance resilience through Three teams providing integrated services according to the following sectors (Health - Protection from Gender-Based Violence) during the project’s lifetime.ltbrgtEach team includes a specialized medical team with a protection team in addition to an administrative staff represented by a data entry officer and a monitoring and evaluation officer.ltbrgtThe project visits the following areas according to a weekly schedule:ltbrgt1- Al-Bab and its countryside.ltbrgt2- East Kweiresltbrgt3- Al-Zarbaltbrgt4- Al-Safiraltbrgt5- Al-Hadir.ltbrgtThe project will encourage the local community to participate in implementing its activities, and its medical services include: providing primary and secondary healthcare through specialized doctors (pediatrics, internal medicine and gynecology, internal medicine and orthopedics, etc.) and trauma services that include mobile trauma consultations, in addition to distributing some auxiliary medical devices and providing specialized consultations including activating the referral system. The project will provide free transportation services to Aleppo city to obtain secondary healthcare services and specialized medical consultations, in addition to activating the permanent medicine card for chronic patients throughout the project period, in addition to qualifying the capacities of healthcare providers in each of the targeted areas.ltbrgtAs for protection, the protection sector services (gender-based violence) are summarized in: providing gender-based violence response services and making them available to survivors of gender-based violence and women and girls at risk through a specialized referral officer, purchasing and distributing dignity kits within awareness sessions, and implementing activities to change negative social norms. These activities include early marriage campaigns and the 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence campaign. In addition to training humanitarian workers to reduce the risks of gender-based violence and training gender-based violence actors to respond to gender-based violence.ltbrgtThe project's services related to gender-based violence will be coordinated with the Protection sector GBV AoR .ltbrgtThe project will operate until 25-12-2025 and during six days a week, the work team will be distributed into two integrated teams and fixed PHC in Arran related to Tadef district. The three teams will start at nine in the morning until four in the afternoon within a monthly work plan distributed across the regions. ltbrgtThere will be direct coordination with the Health Sector in Aleppo city and the project will work to send the necessary reports in addition to coordinating with the protection sector to coordinate services and prevent duplication of service provision and work to ensure that the service is of the highest possible qualitylt/pgt
